content.title: HRB Q1 Deep Dive: Assisted Tax and Small Business Segments Drive Stable Outlook
content.summary: Tax preparation company H&R Block (NYSE:HRB) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 5% year on year to $203.6 million.
